title: MARTY RHONE
tickerText: Marty Rhone has spent decades moving between music, theatre and film without ever missing a beat. He’s shared bills with the Rolling Stones, Bee Gees, John Denver and Peter Allen, and worked alongside names including Yul Brynner, Lou Diamond Phillips and Jackie Weaver. His recording career stretches from the 1960s to the present, including the 2017 US indie country No.1 “Graceland on the Line.” Still writing, recording and performing, Rhone continues to bring a sharp, seasoned voice to country, pop and everything in between.
